description: 港湾台帳 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本県. 県内の港湾施設のリスト（港湾厚生施設）. Coverage: 熊本県. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本県. Its tags are 土木部. It offers 4 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
